sloka: तौ रजन्यां प्रभातायां स्नातौ हुतहुताशनौ ।यथोक्तमृषिणा पूर्वं सर्वं तत्रोपगायताम् ।। ७.९४.१ ॥
transliteration: tau rajanyāṁ prabhātāyāṁ snātau hutahutāśanau ।yathoktamṛṣiṇā pūrvaṁ sarvaṁ tatropagāyatām ।। 7.94.1 ॥

translations.english: When the night dawned, after bathing and performing their fire oblations, the two boys sang the entire Ramayana as previously narrated by the sage Valmiki in that assembly.
